briefing: Trainee pilot checkout at Varda Rim. Turn and pitch, cycle to the training radar, lock and hit it, then intercept three bandits probing the rim.
debrief: Varda Rim held. The quartermaster hands you a sealed case of your missing mentor's radio recordings.
failure: The bandits reach the field. Varda Rim is grounded and Teal's recordings stay locked away.

phases.beat: Tap turn and pitch briefly. Three seconds TOTAL each; impacts reset you.
phases.label: Practice short turn and pitch taps

phases.beat: Select radar: TGT / Tab / Y. Follow marker; turn back if you pass it.
phases.label: Cycle to the training target

phases.beat: Aim for LOCK, then FIRE / Space / RT. Pull up after firing.
phases.label: Lock and hit the training radar

phases.beat: Bandits in 4s. Protection ends on arrival; impacts then fatal.
phases.label: Intercept three bandits

primary: Complete flight training and repel a probing attack
title: FIRST FLIGHT

briefing: Intercept the three-bandit screen, destroy five coastal warehouses while raiders pursue, then down the faster armored ace.
debrief: The coast is quiet. One tape keeps looping: 'They moved the fuel north. Follow the relays.'
failure: The strike force stages unopposed. The coast keeps fuelling the raid on Varda Rim.

phases.beat: SERA: Three bandits over the harbor. Take them.
phases.label: Intercept the three-bandit screen

phases.beat: SERA: Five warehouses feed the raid. Burn them all.
phases.label: Destroy five warehouses

phases.beat: SERA: Their lead is armored. Make every shot count.
phases.label: Destroy the ace

primary: Break the coastal strike force staging against Varda Rim
title: IRON COAST

briefing: Follow Teal's beacons, mark his receiver on a low scan, and clear the scouts between his two canyon routes. Keep a recovery link open until the receiver is reached.
debrief: Recovery reaches the marked receiver with your radio guidance. Its memory points back at our own training grounds.
failure: The scouts close the ridge. Teal's last flight path goes cold.

phases.beat: TEAL (tape): Stay low on the switchback.

chatter.text: TEAL (tape): Third beacon's the one I nearly missed.

phases.label: Follow Teal's beacons

phases.beat: SERA: Scan below the beacons. Recovery needs the receiver marked.

chatter.text: SERA: Receiver echo below the second beacon. Keep scanning.

phases.label: Locate Teal's receiver below the rim

phases.beat: SERA: Two scouts shadowing the rim. Clear the pair.
phases.label: Clear scout flight alpha

phases.beat: TEAL (tape): Under three-twenty along the river. Stay out of sight.

chatter.text: SERA: Bravo flight is hunting the river. Last gate, then turn.

phases.label: Teal's river run: stay under 320

phases.beat: SERA: Bravo flight breaking cover. Three, in two groups. Clear them.
phases.label: Clear scout flight bravo

phases.beat: RECOVERY: We have your mark. Keep the link open while we reach it.

chatter.text: RECOVERY: Receiver in sight. We are climbing down now.

phases.label: Guide recovery onto the receiver

primary: Follow Teal's final flight path along the rim
title: FOX TRAIL

briefing: Scan the rogue training radar for proof, destroy it, and follow the service-road beacons clear. Defeat its response flight, then send the staff list to Varda.
debrief: Varda records all three names before anyone can erase them. The list leads to the orchard witnesses.
failure: The rogue radar keeps watching Varda. The officers behind it stay hidden.

phases.beat: BROADCAST: All Varda units stand down. Authority: Air Marshal.

chatter.text: SERA: Stand down? Nobody at Varda issued that.

phases.label: Scan the quarters: stay under 380

phases.beat: SERA: Proof's recorded. Now kill the radar.
phases.label: Destroy the hidden rim radar

phases.beat: SERA: Evidence copied. Follow the service road clear.

chatter.text: SERA: Road is clear ahead. Keep to the beacon line.

phases.label: Follow the quarters service road

phases.beat: SERA: They scrambled a flight. Five, in two groups. Hold the line.
phases.label: Fend off the response flight

phases.beat: SERA: Varda is copying the names. Hold the link.

chatter.text: TOWER: First two names copied. Send the third.

phases.label: Send the staff list to Varda

primary: Silence an unlisted radar hidden inside the training grounds
title: STATIC QUARTERS

briefing: Cover the orchard trucks to the upland road and drive off the patrol leads. Check both bends for stragglers, report the families' names, and guide the seed tin toward the rim.
debrief: Every family is accounted for at Varda. The seed tin and its map of military silos leave the orchard safely.
failure: The convoy is caught on the open road. The orchard families never reach the uplands.

phases.beat: FARMER: Trucks rolling. Please stay with us.

chatter.text: SERA: Second flight off the ridge. Turn back now.
FARMER: The road's in sight. Don't leave us yet.

phases.label: Cover the orchard evacuation trucks

phases.beat: SERA: Trucks are clear. Their patrol leads are turning in. Three.
phases.label: Drive off the patrol leads

phases.beat: FARMER: One truck lost its radio. Check both bends for stragglers.

chatter.text: FARMER: One bend clear. Check behind the orchard wall too.

phases.label: Check the evacuation road is empty

phases.beat: SERA: All trucks counted. Hold the link for the families' names.

chatter.text: TOWER: Names copied. Finding beds for the children now.

phases.label: Pass the families' names to Varda

phases.beat: FARMER: Seed tin is aboard. Follow our homeward beacons.

chatter.text: FARMER: The lead truck sees your lights. Keep leading.

phases.label: Bring the seed tin toward the rim

primary: Cover the orchard evacuation convoy
title: ORCHARD LINE

briefing: Follow the irrigation channel and scan the marked fuel silos without touching the farm roofs. Burn the stores, clear the patrol, and copy the fuel ledger from the farm crew.
debrief: The silos are gone and the ledger is copied. A farmer identifies the courier who carries the next set of orders.
failure: The fuel grain ships north. The coup's patrols stay supplied.

phases.beat: SERA: Follow the channel. The marked tanks sit at its end.

chatter.text: FARMER: The unmarked roofs are ours. Please.

phases.label: Follow the farm irrigation channel

phases.beat: SERA: Low pass first. Mark the military silos, not the farmhouses.

chatter.text: SERA: Fuel-grade grain in all three. The roofs are clean.

phases.label: Mark fuel silos below 400

phases.beat: SERA: Marked silos only. That grain is fuel.
phases.label: Destroy three fuel silos

phases.beat: SERA: Five answering the smoke, in two groups. Turn into them.
phases.label: Clear the orchard patrol

phases.beat: SERA: The farm crew found the ledger. Hold the link while they read it.

chatter.text: FARMER: Three fuel shipments. All signed by the same officer.

phases.label: Copy the fuel ledger before leaving

primary: Destroy fuel grain silos stockpiling for the coup
title: GRAIN SHADOW

briefing: Run the dust-pass gates and scan the clearings for the courier's trail. Strip his escort, catch him before the plateau, then head toward Varda while reading his packet over the radio.
debrief: Varda copies tomorrow's coup orders and the first relay's name from the courier packet: Node Kiro.
failure: The courier reaches the plateau. Tomorrow's coup orders go out on time.

phases.beat: SERA: The courier runs under the dust. Stay in it.

chatter.text: SERA: Five escorts ahead of him. Dust is thinning.

phases.label: Run the dust pass under 400

phases.beat: SERA: Scan both clearings for his engine trail.

chatter.text: SERA: Engine trail at the second clearing. Keep low.

phases.label: Find the courier's trail in the dust

phases.beat: SERA: Five escorts in the dust, in two groups. Strip them off him.
phases.label: Strip the courier's escort

phases.beat: SERA: There's the courier, running north. Ninety seconds. Catch him.

chatter.text: SERA: He's halfway to the plateau. Close on him.
SERA: Twenty seconds and he's over the edge!

phases.label: Catch the courier before the plateau

phases.beat: SERA: Packet recovered. Head for Varda while I read the orders.

chatter.text: SERA: Tomorrow's orders copied. Reading the signatures next.

phases.label: Carry the courier packet toward Varda

primary: Intercept a storm-day messenger crossing the canyon pass
title: DUST WEATHER

briefing: Protect Varda's tower while crews restore its code. Scan the smoke for spotters before striking, clear the retreating flight, and stay until loyal pilots acknowledge the restored code.
debrief: The restored code reaches every loyal flight. Varda holds, but Vulture Lead is still hunting the night approach.
failure: Varda's tower stays in coup hands, and the rim airfield goes with it.

phases.beat: SERA: Tower crew resetting the code. Keep the raiders off them.

chatter.text: BROADCAST: Varda tower is in rebel hands. Fire on it.
SERA: Ignore that. It's him.
SERA: Second wave's dropping smoke on the apron. Spotters.

phases.label: Protect Varda's control tower

phases.beat: SERA: Smoke on the apron. Scan for the two spotter dishes first.

chatter.text: SERA: Two dishes in the smoke. Keep the parked trainers clear.

phases.label: Mark the apron spotters

phases.beat: SERA: Code is ours. Two spotter radars on the apron. Hit them.
phases.label: Counter-attack the spotter radars

phases.beat: SERA: Spotters down. Their flight is running. Catch three.
phases.label: Catch the retreating flight

phases.beat: TOWER: Code restored. Stay on the link until every loyal flight answers.

chatter.text: TOWER: Loyal flight answering. Waiting on the last one.

phases.label: Send the restored tower code

primary: Hold Varda Rim through a coordinated counter-strike
title: RIM SWITCH

aceReturns: SERA: Vulture Lead's turning back in. Nose on him.
VULTURE LEAD: Head on, trainee. Like he did.
aceStages: VULTURE LEAD: You fly like him. He died anyway. Wing, cut him off.
VULTURE LEAD: Enough. Wing, on me!
briefing: Follow the night lights and locate Vulture Lead's guard-channel source. Clear his patrol, draw him onto the open channel, defeat him, then mark his recorder for recovery.
debrief: Recovery reaches Vulture Lead's recorder. Teal's cut-off transmission links the farms to the coastal harbors.
failure: Vulture Lead holds the pass. Teal's final transmission stays buried with the witness.

phases.beat: SERA: The approach lights are his bait. Fly them anyway.

chatter.text: VULTURE LEAD: Teal flew this line too. Keep coming.

phases.label: Follow the night approach lights

phases.beat: SERA: His voice is bouncing off the pass. Scan low to mark the source.

chatter.text: SERA: Guard-channel source above the pass. That is him.

phases.label: Find Vulture Lead's guard-channel source

phases.beat: SERA: Three on night vision, in two groups. Watch your horizon.
phases.label: Clear the night patrol

phases.beat: SERA: Patrol is gone. Hold the channel open. He will come to answer.

chatter.text: VULTURE LEAD: You have my attention, trainee. Stay there.

phases.label: Draw Vulture Lead onto the open channel

phases.beat: Vulture Lead. He erased the witness. Not you.
phases.label: Defeat Vulture Lead

phases.beat: RECOVERY: Recorder still transmitting. Mark it before the signal dies.

chatter.text: RECOVERY: Recorder ping steady. Mark the second slope.

phases.label: Mark Vulture Lead's recorder

primary: Night sweep over the pass; Vulture Lead is waiting
title: STATIC HORIZON

briefing: Scan Node Kiro's archive; if intercepted, clear the camp flight and finish copying. Cut the transmitter, trace the command channel to its hidden radar, destroy it, then clear the blind response.
debrief: Kiro's archive is safe and its directing radar is dark. Loyalist traffic returns with evidence linking the next two relays.
failure: Node Kiro keeps transmitting. Loyalist traffic stays jammed.

phases.beat: SERA: Scan the archive first. The dish can wait.

chatter.text: SERA: Signatures copying. Stay low. Hold fire.

phases.label: Scan Node Kiro (hold fire)

insert.beat: SERA: Four off the camp, in pairs. Clear them, then we finish the scan.
insert.label: Break the camp's intercept

insert.beat: SERA: Back on the archive. Eight seconds of clean copy.

chatter.text: SERA: Copy complete in four. Hold your line.

insert.label: Finish the archive scan

twist.text: SERA: They've seen you. Four climbing off the camp. Scan's on hold.

phases.beat: SERA: Archive copied. Cut the transmitter.
phases.label: Cut Node Kiro's transmitter

insert.beat: SERA: Hold the channel while we trace the camp radar.

chatter.text: SERA: The radar is still directing them. Trace is closing.

insert.label: Trace the camp radar's command channel

insert.beat: SERA: Radar on the camp roof. Its raiders fire twice as fast. Kill it.
insert.label: Kill the camp radar

twist.text: SERA: Radar is directing them. Hold the channel; we will trace it.

phases.beat: SERA: Radar's dead. The response is flying blind. Three.
phases.label: Intercept the blind response

primary: Scout and silence the first plateau relay
title: PLATEAU COLD

briefing: Take Lira and Merel on opposite ridges while clearing their alert flights. Follow the farm-road beacons to the unlisted third dish, then relay Teal's packet from the west ridge.
debrief: Lira, Merel and the unlisted Sable fall. The west-ridge handoff reaches a loyalist cell with coordinates for a staging farm.
failure: Lira, Merel and Sable keep the farm belt deaf. Teal's packet never reaches the loyalists.

phases.beat: SERA: Lira first. West ridge dish.
phases.label: Destroy relay Node Lira

phases.beat: SERA: Alert flight airborne. Three. Clear them.
phases.label: Clear the alert flight

phases.beat: SERA: Merel next. East ridge.
phases.label: Destroy relay Node Merel

insert.beat: SERA: Farm road north. Two beacons to Sable.

chatter.text: FARMER: That dish went up last week. Nobody asked us.

insert.label: Follow the farm road north to Sable

insert.beat: SERA: Sable. Dish only. The barn beside it is ours.
insert.label: Destroy relay Node Sable

insert.beat: SERA: Guard flight off Sable. Three.
insert.label: Clear Sable's guard flight

twist.text: SERA: Third dish lit north of the belt. Node Sable. Not on the tin.

phases.beat: SERA: Relaying Teal's packet. Ninety seconds. Hold the ridge orbit.

chatter.text: FARMER: We're hearing it. Keep it coming.
SERA: Last of the packet. Don't drift off the ridge.

phases.label: Relay Teal's packet from the west ridge

primary: Harvest the relays flanking the farm belt
title: SIGNAL HARVEST

briefing: Escort the transmitter through the refugee corridor. When false orders divert it, stop at the fork and scan the mill road before covering the new leg; clear the patrol, test the link, and lead in relief.
debrief: The truck reaches the mill road safely, its new link answers, and relief takes over. The farms now have a working relay net.
failure: The transmitter truck is lost. The loyalist cells have no relay net.

phases.beat: TRUCK: Transmitter rolling. The corridor is full of refugees.

chatter.text: SERA: Second flight coming for the truck.

phases.label: Escort the loyalist transmitter truck

insert.beat: SERA: Ignore him. North is mined. Truck, stop. Scan the mill road.

chatter.text: SERA: Refugees clear of the bend. One more look at the road.

insert.label: Check the mill road for refugees

insert.beat: SERA: Mill road is clear. Truck, swing east. We will cover you.

chatter.text: TRUCK: Mill road's rough but we're moving. Stay with us.

insert.label: Cover the reroute along the mill road

twist.text: BROADCAST: Convoy, the north corridor is clear. Proceed north at speed.

phases.beat: SERA: Truck's clear. Patrol escalating. Six, in two groups.
phases.label: Occupy the orchard airspace

phases.beat: TRUCK: Parked and transmitting. Hold for our first reply.

chatter.text: TRUCK: First loyalist cell answering. Holding for the second.

phases.label: Test the truck's new relay link

phases.beat: SERA: Relief crew following your beacons. Bring them to the truck.

chatter.text: SERA: Relief crew sees the transmitter. Last beacon ahead.

phases.label: Lead the relief crew to the truck

primary: Escort the loyalist transmitter truck across the orchards
title: OPEN FIELD

briefing: Follow the rail spur and scan the military stores among civilian roofs. Destroy four silos, clear the responding flights and cut the relay, then send the rail crew's ledger to the cells.
debrief: The staging farm is dark. Its copied ledger reaches the cells and points to the plateau antenna chain.
failure: The staging farm keeps feeding the coup's fuel chain.

phases.beat: SERA: Rail spur runs straight to their stores. Follow it.

chatter.text: SERA: Spur ends at the silos. Low and quiet now.

phases.label: Follow the rail spur to the staging farm

phases.beat: SERA: Mark the stores. Civilian roofs stay standing.

chatter.text: SERA: Fuel ledger confirmed. Those silos are military.

phases.label: Scan the staging farm low

phases.beat: SERA: Four silos. Marked only.
phases.label: Destroy four fuel silos

insert.beat: SERA: Silos burning. Now the four, in pairs. Turn in.
insert.label: Break the plateau reinforcements

twist.text: SERA: Four off the plateau. Finish the silos, then turn into them.

phases.beat: SERA: The relay's still calling for help. Cut it.
phases.label: Destroy the farm relay

phases.beat: SERA: Raiders off the plateau. Three more, with hangers-on.
phases.label: Hold off the raiders

phases.beat: SERA: Rail crew has the ledger. Hold the link to the cells.

chatter.text: LOYALIST: Rail ledger copied. Matching it against Kiro's orders.

phases.label: Send the staging ledger to the cells

primary: Dismantle the coup's upland staging farm
title: STAGING FARM

briefing: Cross the saddle beacons and strike the three antennas. Locate the replacement dish on the saddle road before destroying it, clear the perimeter flight, and listen until the whole chain is silent.
debrief: The replacement mast falls with the fixed row. A final listening check confirms the coup has switched to courier runs.
failure: The antenna row stays lit. The coup's chain of command stays intact.

phases.beat: SERA: Saddle beacons lead to the arrays. Climb.

chatter.text: SERA: All three arrays can hear you now.
BROADCAST: Unknown aircraft on the saddle. Intercept.

phases.label: Cross the four saddle beacons

phases.beat: SERA: Three dishes on the ridge. Blind them.
phases.label: Destroy three plateau antennas

insert.beat: SERA: Scan the saddle road. They have raised a replacement dish.

chatter.text: SERA: Dish truck on the saddle road. Civilian vans are clear.

insert.label: Find the saddle-road replacement mast

insert.beat: SERA: Mast located on the saddle road. Hit the dish.
insert.label: Destroy the mobile mast

twist.text: SERA: Replacement mast on the saddle road. Cut that one too.

phases.beat: SERA: Perimeter CAP turning in. Four, in pairs, with raiders.
phases.label: Clear the perimeter CAP

phases.beat: SERA: Hold the saddle. I'm listening for anything left alive.

chatter.text: SERA: More off the dark end of the row. Hold the orbit.
SERA: Nothing on the chain. Almost there.

phases.label: Hold the saddle: confirm the row is dark

primary: Blind the long-range antenna row at night
title: ANTENNA ROW

briefing: Hold the loyalist broadcast link and destroy any jammers that block it. Clear the second intruders, follow the garrisons' reply beacons, and scan both compounds to confirm they stood down.
debrief: The broadcast lands and the reply is verified from the air. Loyalist garrisons park their aircraft instead of following the forged orders.
failure: The broadcast is jammed. The garrisons stay with the coup.

phases.beat: LOYALIST: Transmitting. Every second is a garrison.

chatter.text: SERA: Raiders inbound. Stay inside the volume.
LOYALIST: Garrisons answering. Keep the volume.

hazard.text: LOYALIST: Link lost! Kill the two jammer trucks on the farm road.

phases.label: Hold the broadcast link

phases.beat: SERA: Second wave, riding harder. Seven, in two groups. Raiders in tow.
phases.label: Hold the second intruders

phases.beat: LOYALIST: Two reply beacons lit. Follow them to check the garrisons.

chatter.text: LOYALIST: West garrison beacon confirmed. East is ahead.

phases.label: Follow the garrisons' reply beacons

phases.beat: SERA: Scan both compounds for parked aircraft. Verify they stood down.

chatter.text: SERA: Engines cold at the first compound. Check the second.

phases.label: Confirm the garrisons have stood down

primary: Buy the loyalist broadcast its one clear window
title: LOYALIST WINDOW

briefing: Run the river gates under the storm and identify the last fuel stores in the rain. Burn them, clear the diving patrol, cut the forward relay, and copy its final traffic.
debrief: The stores and relay are dark. Their copied traffic identifies the crown station carrying the Marshal's real signature.
failure: The last staging site survives the storm and the fuel keeps moving.

phases.beat: SERA: River gates keep you under the storm. Stay low.

chatter.text: SERA: Last gate. The marked tanks are just past it.

phases.label: River gates: stay under 400

phases.beat: SERA: Rain hides the markings. Scan both ends before you fire.

chatter.text: SERA: Fuel markings visible. Keep the farm roofs out of the strike.

phases.label: Identify fuel stores in the rain

phases.beat: SERA: Three silos under the storm. Burn them.
phases.label: Destroy three remaining silos

insert.beat: SERA: Patrol riding the thunder. Five, in two groups.
insert.label: Catch the storm patrol

twist.text: SERA: Five diving through the cloud. Finish the tanks and turn.

phases.beat: SERA: Forward relay on the staging path. Cut it.
phases.label: Destroy the forward relay

phases.beat: SERA: Hold over the relay. Its last traffic is still in the air.

chatter.text: SERA: Pair off the plateau, using the storm. Hold the orbit.
SERA: Second pair, coming out of the rain.

phases.label: Read the dead relay's last traffic

primary: Finish the staging ground while the storm covers you
title: STORM WALK

briefing: Cut the crown relay and clear its intercepts, then receive the archive. If the signal breaks, scan beneath the array, kill the jammer and its escort, and return to finish receiving the signature.
debrief: The resumed receive orbit brings the complete signed order home: Air Marshal Rusk. Vulture Two challenges your call sign.
failure: The aurora relay stays hot. The Marshal's signature stays hidden.

phases.beat: SERA: One dish under the aurora. Cut it.
phases.label: Destroy the plateau relay

phases.beat: SERA: Four intercepts lit by the aurora, in pairs.
phases.label: Clear the aurora intercept

phases.beat: TEAL (tape): If you hear this up here, read the signature.

chatter.text: SERA: The archive is speaking. Signature decoding.

phases.label: Orbit to receive the archive

insert.beat: SERA: Get under the aurora glow. It'll show on the scan.

chatter.text: SERA: There. A dish truck in the array's shadow.

insert.label: Find the jammer under the array

insert.beat: SERA: Jammer marked. Cut it.
insert.label: Destroy the aurora jammer

insert.beat: SERA: Its escort is up. Two.
insert.label: Clear the jammer's escort

insert.beat: SERA: Archive's back. Hold the orbit. Read the signature.

chatter.text: SERA: Signature decoding. Hold. It carries a Marshal's seal.

insert.label: Resume the receive orbit

twist.text: SERA: Archive lost. Jammer under the array. Find it, low.

primary: Hunt the last plateau relay under the aurora
title: AURORA RELAY

aceReturns: VULTURE TWO: Now. Again, trainee. From the top.
VULTURE TWO: Head on. The way Teal never would.
aceStages: VULTURE TWO: I taught him that turn. Wing, show the trainee the answer.
VULTURE TWO: Last lesson. Wing, keep him busy.
briefing: Climb into Vulture Two's lights and mark a safe pickup site before clearing his wingmen. Defeat him through three stages, protect the marines' recovery, and relay his testimony to the coast.
debrief: The marines recover Vulture Two alive from the ridge. His recorded testimony reaches the coast before the next strike.
failure: Vulture Two holds the plateau. The road to the coast stays shut.

phases.beat: VULTURE TWO: Climb into my lights, trainee.

chatter.text: VULTURE TWO: Teal climbed faster. Show me more.

phases.label: Climb into Vulture Two's searchlights

phases.beat: MARINE: Mark a clear pickup site. We need his answers alive.

chatter.text: MARINE: Ridge landing zone clear. We can bring a helo there.

phases.label: Mark a safe ridge pickup site

phases.beat: SERA: His wingmen first. Four, in pairs.
phases.label: Clear his wingmen

phases.beat: He flies like Teal. Teal learned it from him.
phases.label: Defeat Vulture Two

insert.beat: MARINE: We have him. Forty-five seconds to get him off the ridge.

chatter.text: SERA: His second pair is diving on the pickup. Hold them.
MARINE: Helo's spinning up. Almost out.

insert.label: Protect the marines' pickup on the ridge

twist.text: SERA: Chute open. His wing is turning back. Cover the marines' pickup.

phases.beat: MARINE: He is talking. Coast is recording. Hold the link.

chatter.text: MARINE: He admits the handwriting. Coast is recording every word.

phases.label: Relay Vulture Two's testimony

primary: Close act two against the plateau ace
title: RIDGE ACE

briefing: Scan the military quays, burn the stores and break the early intercept. Trace a safe lane for the workers' launch, escort it clear, defeat the remaining flight and open the rescue channel.
debrief: The military stores burn while harbor workers reach safety. Their rescue channel stays open as Rusk moves into the city.
failure: The harbor reserves survive. The coup keeps its coastal logistics.

phases.beat: SERA: Watch what the cranes unload. Mark the quays.

chatter.text: SERA: Those crates are munitions. The quays are military.

phases.label: Scan the quays; spare the city

phases.beat: SERA: Three military quays. Hit the warehouses.
phases.label: Destroy three harbor warehouses

insert.beat: SERA: Early pair off the apron. Clear them.
insert.label: Break the early CAP

twist.text: SERA: Early CAP pair launching. Finish the quay, then turn in.

phases.beat: HARBOR: Follow the three quay beacons. Our launch needs a clear way out.

chatter.text: HARBOR: First bend clear. Last beacon marks the open channel.

phases.label: Trace the workers' escape lane

phases.beat: HARBOR: Workers aboard. Cover our launch clear of the burning quays.

chatter.text: HARBOR: All workers counted. Past the worst of the smoke.

phases.label: Escort the harbor workers

phases.beat: SERA: Main CAP off the apron. Four, in two groups.
phases.label: Clear the harbor CAP

phases.beat: HARBOR: Quays clear. Hold the channel while we count our people.

chatter.text: HARBOR: First crew answering. Still calling the eastern quay.

phases.label: Open the harbor rescue frequency

primary: First strike on the coup's harbor logistics
title: HARBOR RUN

briefing: Break the eastern wing and scan the launch's exit. Cover Teal's paper evidence through the harbor, silence the bank guns, mark the patrol boat's approach and confirm the handoff over the radio.
debrief: The launch clears the guns and transfers Teal's evidence at sea. Marines confirm the archive and tapes are safely aboard.
failure: The Marshal's air cover holds together. The evidence never leaves the harbor.

phases.beat: SERA: Full wing on the east line. Nine, in three groups.
phases.label: Shatter the eastern wing

phases.beat: MARINE: Paper is aboard. Scan the harbor exit before we move.

chatter.text: MARINE: Exit marked. We will move as soon as your scan is clear.

phases.label: Scan the launch's exit

phases.beat: MARINE: Launch moving. Keep the sky quiet.

chatter.text: SERA: Western wing reacting. Launch is halfway out.

hazard.text: MARINE: Guns on both banks, firing on the launch! Silence them!

phases.label: Cover the evidence launch

phases.beat: MARINE: Holding at the exit. Mark the patrol boat's approach beacons.

chatter.text: MARINE: Patrol boat sees your mark. One more beacon.

phases.label: Mark the open-water rendezvous

phases.beat: MARINE: Patrol boat alongside. Hold until the paper changes hands.

chatter.text: MARINE: Archive case passed. Tapes are next.

phases.label: Confirm the evidence handoff at sea

primary: Split the Air Marshal's air cover in half
title: FRACTURE LINE

briefing: Follow the dark canal and mark the dish above the apartments before firing. Clear the escort, confirm the tower is silent, cover the repair launch and guide its crew to the dark district.
debrief: Rusk's tower stays silent. Repair crews reach the district while its residents open their windows to the quiet.
failure: The broadcast tower keeps talking. The city hears only Rusk.

phases.beat: SERA: The dark canal keeps you off his radar. Follow it.

chatter.text: SERA: Relay above the apartments. Hit only the dish.

phases.label: Follow the dark canal through the city

phases.beat: SERA: Low scan over the canal. Mark the dish above the roofs.

chatter.text: SERA: Dish marked. Apartment roofs stay standing.

phases.label: Mark the dish above the apartments

phases.beat: SERA: Broadcast relay above the city. Dish only.
phases.label: Destroy the broadcast relay

phases.beat: SERA: Escort flight scrambling. Four, in two pairs.
phases.label: Hold off the escort flight

phases.beat: SERA: Hold over the tower. I want to hear nothing from it.

chatter.text: SERA: Pair off the dark side of the city. Hold the orbit.
SERA: Still silent. Hold it.

phases.label: Confirm the dark tower is silent

phases.beat: HARBOR: Repair crew moving. Cover us to the dark district.

chatter.text: HARBOR: Crew passing the canal bend. Keep the approach clear.

phases.label: Cover the repair launch

phases.beat: HARBOR: Launch moored. Follow district lights to guide the shore crew.

chatter.text: HARBOR: Shore crew sees your mark. Moving to the next street.

phases.label: Mark the repair crew's district route

primary: Night strike on the Marshal's broadcast tower
title: CITY NIGHT

briefing: Scan and destroy the five fuel depots, follow the empty piers and clear the fog patrol. Escort the inspection launch, verify the last two hoses are dry and report to the frigates.
debrief: Inspectors verify every fuel hose is dry. The frigates receive proof that Rusk's escape fleet cannot refuel.
failure: The fuel depots survive the fog. The Marshal's convoy sails.

phases.beat: SERA: The fog depots carry his signature. Find them.

chatter.text: SERA: Permits match. Every depot is fuel.

phases.label: Find the depots through the fog

phases.beat: SERA: Five depots in the fog. All marked.
phases.label: Destroy five fuel depots

phases.beat: SERA: Follow the pier beacons. Check the whole fuel line is cut.

chatter.text: SERA: West pier empty. Follow the lights to the east.

phases.label: Follow the empty fuel piers

phases.beat: SERA: Patrol riding the fog. Four, in two pairs.
phases.label: Clear the fog patrol

phases.beat: HARBOR: Cannot see the piers. Cover us while we check the hoses.

chatter.text: HARBOR: Inspectors at the central pier. Fuel line looks dry.

phases.label: Cover the harbor inspection launch

phases.beat: HARBOR: Scan the last two piers. We need proof every hose is dry.

chatter.text: HARBOR: First hose disconnected. Check the eastern pier too.

phases.label: Verify the last two fuel hoses are dry

phases.beat: HARBOR: Hoses dry. Hold the link for the frigates to copy.

chatter.text: FRIGATE: Report copied. The escape fleet cannot refuel.

phases.label: Report the escape fleet is out of fuel

primary: Finish the harbor in the fog
title: HARBOR FOG

briefing: Defend the command frigate, scan the last gap and clear the platform flight. Sweep the outer beacons, cover the inspection launch across the gap and send the closed-ring report to the landing force.
debrief: The inspected blockade is closed. The landing force receives confirmation that no fuel ship can reach the platform.
failure: The ring breaks. Fuel ships slip through to the platform.

phases.beat: FRIGATE: Ring closing. Raiders on the bow.

chatter.text: FRIGATE: Second group off the platform. Hold them.
FRIGATE: Third group, low on the water. Two left in the ring.

phases.label: Defend the command frigate

phases.beat: FRIGATE: One gap open. Scan the water before we close the ring.

chatter.text: FRIGATE: No wake in the gap. Finish the sweep.

phases.label: Check the gap between the frigates

phases.beat: FRIGATE: Ring closed. Command flight launching. Four, from both sides.
phases.label: Clear the platform command flight

phases.beat: FRIGATE: Follow the outer beacons. Check the whole sea lane is in sight.

chatter.text: FRIGATE: Western lane visible. Sweep to the eastern beacon.

phases.label: Fly the blockade's outer beacons

phases.beat: FRIGATE: Inspection launch crossing. Cover it until it docks.

chatter.text: FRIGATE: Inspection launch halfway across. Gap remains clear.

phases.label: Cover the blockade inspection launch

phases.beat: FRIGATE: No ships through. Hold the command link for the landing force.

chatter.text: LANDING FORCE: Ring report received. Bringing our boats forward.

phases.label: Report the blockade is closed

primary: Hold the frigate ring around the Marshal's platform
title: OCEAN CLEAR

briefing: Fly the low sea gates, burn the platform stores and break the storm patrol. Find and stop the escaping tanker, cover the deck crew's rescue launch and confirm nothing else has lifted.
debrief: The tanker is stopped and the deck crew rescued. The frigate confirms the platform's fuel chain is broken.
failure: The platform reserves survive. The Marshal can wait out the blockade.

phases.beat: SERA: Under the storm. Three gates to the platform.

chatter.text: SERA: Last gate. The deck stores are ahead.

phases.label: Low sea approach: under 360

phases.beat: SERA: Three stores on the deck. Burn them.
phases.label: Destroy three platform warehouses

phases.beat: SERA: Patrol in the storm shadow. Five, in two groups.
phases.label: Clear the storm patrol

phases.beat: SERA: Scan below the cloud. The tanker is hiding behind the deck smoke.

chatter.text: SERA: Engine heat below the cloud. It is running for the coast.

phases.label: Find the tanker in the storm shadow

phases.beat: SERA: Tanker jet lifting off, running for the coast. Stop it.

chatter.text: SERA: Tanker's halfway to the coast. Close on it.
SERA: He's almost over the city. Now!

phases.label: Stop the escaping fuel tanker

phases.beat: FRIGATE: Deck crew aboard. Cover them clear of the burning stores.

chatter.text: FRIGATE: Launch halfway clear. Deck crew accounted for.

phases.label: Escort the deck crew's rescue launch

phases.beat: FRIGATE: Tanker down. Hold while we check for other launches.

chatter.text: FRIGATE: No second tanker on radar. Checking the last deck returns.

phases.label: Report the platform fuel chain is broken

primary: Strike the offshore platform through the storm
title: PLATFORM FIRE

briefing: Escort the landing craft to the beach and defeat the first intercept. Scan both beach exits, stop the rear attack, cut the directing relay and hold the link until both landing squads answer.
debrief: Both squads confirm the beach exits are held. The loyalists advance into the city as Rusk brings his personal flight airborne.
failure: The landing is pushed back into the sea. The city stays in coup hands.

phases.beat: LANDING CRAFT: Beach in eighty seconds. Keep them off us.

chatter.text: SERA: Second intercept launching. Stay on the craft.
LANDING CRAFT: Surf line. Ramps going down.

phases.label: Cover the landing craft to the beach

phases.beat: SERA: First intercept off the apron. Three, in two groups.
phases.label: Hold the first intercept

phases.beat: LANDING CRAFT: Ramps down. Scan both exits so we can leave the sand.

chatter.text: LANDING CRAFT: West exit clear. Check the eastern street.

phases.label: Mark the safe route off the beach

phases.beat: SERA: Second wave with raiders, coming round behind. Hold the beach.
phases.label: Hold the second intercept

phases.beat: SERA: Beach relay is still directing fire. Cut it.
phases.label: Destroy the beach relay

phases.beat: LANDING CRAFT: Streets reached. Hold for both beach exits to answer.

chatter.text: LANDING CRAFT: West exit answering. Waiting for the eastern squad.

phases.label: Confirm both beach exits are held

primary: Cover the loyalist landing at the city dawn
title: CITY DAWN

briefing: Break the split wing, watching for the rear flight at halfway. Map the rooftop echoes, fix Rusk's transmission, follow the loyalist corridor and protect the quay and witness launch.
debrief: Rusk's wing is broken and his position confirmed. The witnesses reach parliament under your cover.
failure: The Marshal's wing escapes the city. His last flight stays protected.

phases.beat: SERA: Wing splits. Four ahead; the rest will come round behind.
groupCalls: SERA: Second flight on your six! Turn!
phases.label: Break the Marshal's wing

phases.beat: SERA: Signal bouncing between roofs. Scan low to narrow it down.

chatter.text: SERA: Rooftop echoes mapped. We still need the name of the mast.

phases.label: Scan the signal below the skyline

phases.beat: TEAL (tape): He'll be where he can hear himself. The parliament mast.

chatter.text: SERA: Triangulating. He's above the parliament transmitter.
SERA: Fix is closing. Stay in the volume.

phases.label: Triangulate Rusk's transmission

phases.beat: SERA: Loyalists marked a corridor. Follow two lights into the city.

chatter.text: SERA: Loyalists see your lights. Follow the last city beacon.

phases.label: Follow the loyalists' city corridor

phases.beat: MARINE: Secure the quay while witnesses board. Cover the marked site.

chatter.text: MARINE: Witnesses boarding. Quay remains secure.

phases.label: Protect the parliament quay launch

phases.beat: MARINE: Witnesses aboard. Keep us covered until parliament is in sight.

chatter.text: MARINE: Parliament in sight. Witnesses still aboard.

phases.label: Cover the witness launch to parliament

primary: Trap the Marshal's wing between you and the city
title: FRACTURE LAST

aceReturns: SERA: Rusk is turning back in. Here he comes.
RUSK: Then hear it from me. Head on.
aceStages: RUSK: Every relay says I am the law. Yours is a child's radio. Wing!
RUSK: Teal obeyed until the one order that mattered. Wing, finish him.
briefing: Clear Rusk's wing, cut his relay and defeat his last escort. Mark a safe landing strip, bring him down through three stages, climb Teal's beacon line and broadcast the evidence to the coast.
debrief: Rusk is in custody on the marked road. The coast hears Teal's evidence in your voice: 'For Teal. For the rim.'
failure: Rusk escapes. The coup survives, and Teal's evidence is never heard.

phases.beat: His wingmen first. Then him.
phases.label: Clear the Marshal's wingmen

phases.beat: SERA: His relay is still broadcasting. Cut it.
phases.label: Destroy the final broadcast relay

insert.beat: SERA: His last escort pair is forming on him. Clear them.
insert.label: Break the Marshal's personal escort

twist.text: RUSK: You cut one relay. Every loyal pilot still hears me. On me, now.

phases.beat: MARINE: Mark the clear road below him. We need Rusk alive to answer.

chatter.text: MARINE: Clear road marked. We are ready to take him into custody.

phases.label: Mark Rusk's emergency landing strip

phases.beat: That's his jet. Teal's voice on his tapes. Bring him down.
phases.label: Defeat the Air Marshal

phases.beat: SERA: Rusk is down. Follow three lights to Teal's broadcast line.

chatter.text: SERA: One more light. Above it, the whole coast can hear you.

phases.label: Climb to Teal's clear broadcast line

phases.beat: SERA: You're on every frequency. Say it your way.

chatter.text: SERA: Last of his diehards. Keep them off the signal.
HARBOR: Loyalist pilots answering. Every harbor.

phases.label: Broadcast Teal's evidence coastwide

primary: Confront the Air Marshal and finish the broadcast
title: BROKEN RELAY
